mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 7.0%, it signals economic distress and risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP and housing starts indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST show positive growth.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% YoY, it signals high inflation prompting central bank tightening, reducing equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals weakening supply chains and economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When payrolls growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, it indicates a strong labor market boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in retail sales and housing starts signal strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST show positive growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, it signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.
